book.name: 1 KORENTE
book.title: Mukaana A Poole wu a nsomo kundaa basi Korente

content: Mimfwunu ŋa kara li bandughu mu kana
Ŋaala mbwuru mumõ mu be li a ndagha ya mbwuru mukimi, bunu nde akughu osa nde mumfwunu ŋa nkulu a bansughu a lamana ba bagwene a kana mu Nzaami, lo ka ŋa nkulu a baana ba Nzaami o?
Be ka lisoolo o ti me baana ba Nzaami akala baalamana nsie? Ya kala ti me mu be akala baalamana nsie, bunu be ka likughu olamana mandagha ma magwene a mupfunu o?
Be ka lisoolo o ti me bihi-a-be akala liilamana bangye-yulu? Mu obo mu emakye bihi-a-be ka likughu olamana mandagha ma matala bumweẽ bu o?
Mu obo, kala ti be lili a muyala ya banganda mu mi mitala mandagha mama bumweẽ, be liikagwolo bansughu a lamana baara ba ookamono libwunu li Nzaami ti bo ka bali a mupfunu o!
Me ndyele obo mu otwuhu be budzwa. Mu obo, ŋa kara li be ka oli a mbwuru si mumõ wuli a bunsughu wu kughu olamana bandughu ba nde mu kana o?
Lo bunu ndughu mu kana mumõ, li mu okasa ndughu wu muke mumfwunu ŋa nkulu a bansughu a lamana ba bagwene a kana mu Nzaami!

Mu mi mitala be, be ayi bikwono bu lili a mimfwunu be a be. Mu emakye be lili mu ogwene okakuru mukolo mu mandagha maala ka mali mama nsumu o? Mu emakye be lili mu ogwene okakihi ti bagwohono be bilogho bi lili a bye?
Lo me be lili mu okagyighili mandagha maala ka mali mama bunsumu o ya lili mu okagwohono bilogho bi babake, ya bo bali bandughu mu kana!

Be ka lisoolo o ti ba bagwene a bunsumu akala ka bagwolo pfa li Emfumu e Nzaami o? Ka lipfiri manyuru ma beme o: Ka oli banga a enkwunu o, ba baakasamana banzaami baba mpya, ba baakabvughu mbughu ya bakala bwunu we balumu ba banganda, babaghala ba bali a bipfu bi bakaha, babaghala ba baakabvughu mbughu ya bambaala babaghala,
banga a pfyibi, banga a ntono a nzi, binkolo-mala, banga a bitughu bwunu we ba baakagwohono bilogho bi baara, bo ka bagwolo pfa li Emfumu e Nzaami o.
Ankoho obo me bu óli babake ŋa kara li be. Lo be ayi baaswagha be, be ayi baasi be baba ngili, be ayi baba bunsumu mu nkwumu a Mfumu Yiisu-Kriste ya mu Mufulu a Nzaami a bihi.
Ligwa Nzaami masyighi mu manyuru ma be
Me ndi a muswa mu ogyighili mandagha mwohono, lo mandagha mwohono ka mali a ndaana o. Me ndi a muswa mu ogyighili mandagha mwohono, lo me, me ka nkihi okala nkana a elogho si emõ o.
Bi-odza bili bibi mila, ya mila mili mimi bi-odza. Nzaami sa adzihibi bi-odza ya mila. Lo nyuru ka yili yi a enkwunu o, yo yili yi a Mfumu, bwunu a bu oli Mfumu wu a ndaa nyuru.
Ankoho Nzaami wu aasiili Mfumu ŋa kara li ba bákpi, sa asiili bihi si ŋa kara li ba bákpi mu lileene li Nde.
Be ka lisoolo o ti manyuru ma be mali binama bi nyuru a Kriste? Me nkughu ogwolo binama bi nyuru a Kriste mu osa bye binama bi nyuru a mukaha nga a enkwunu? Si okala ka bunu!
Be ka lisoolo o ti mbwuru wu aabvughu mbughu ya mukaha nga a enkwunu bo ya nde ayi nyuru mõ? Mu kuulu bályele ti: «Bo bansa buolo sa bakala nyuru mõ.»
Lo munde wu aakala emõ ya Mfumu li ya Nde mu mufulu mumõ.
Libara enkwunu. Nswe lisumu li oogyighili mbwuru lili ku mbala a nyuru a nde, lo wu aasi enkwunu aasi lisumu mu nyuru a ndeme.
Bunu, be ka lisoolo o ti nyuru a be yili nzo a Mufulu a Ngili wu li mu be, Mufulu wu oogwi be Nzaami? Manyuru ma be ka maafirisyili mama ndaa beme o,
mu kuulu bákwulu be mu mutala wu bvulu. Mu obo liikasyighi Nzaami mu manyuru ma be.
